name: How to Clean a Scanned PDF
description: Whiten scanned-page backgrounds and sharpen text — free, no upload required.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Pick a mode and strength
step.text: Choose Clean or Enhance, then adjust the strength slider. The live before/after preview updates as you go.

step.name: Download your cleaned PDF
step.text: Click 'Clean & Download'. Every page is processed and ready to download instantly.
